title: Wolf at the Door
description: A large black wolf with glowing white eyes peers through an open doorway from a dark wooden porch. The interior is dimly lit with wooden steps and railings, while the twilight sky shows faint purple and pink hues above a smoky, desolate landscape.
prompt: A large silhouetted black wolf with one visible glowing white eye stands at an open wooden doorway on a dark porch at twilight. The wolf looks into a dimly lit interior with wooden steps and railings. The sky is a dark gradient of deep purple and faint pink, with smoke drifting in the background, moody cinematic lighting, painterly brushstrokes, dark atmosphere.
